name: Burger, Gourmet
body:
Station and Complexity grillardin 4, line cook 4

Flavor Profiles texture, umami, temperature, texture
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 1d4
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A gourmet burger is a richer, more flavorful version of a simple burger, with more sauces and vegetables and, if one wants, slices of softened cheese.

When consumed, it grants a haste effect, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.

Additional sour and spicy ingredients add an additional +5 ft. of speed each.
